additional_info.subject: RE: ID0425695-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P9 312561850/08]Terminal-Card Connection Issues CRM:02681000191
additional_info.body:
Hi
Emeline,
We have analyzed the snapshot you shared and identified a communication issue with EcoG, which is causing the handshake process to fail in a timely manner. EcoG communicates with the PLC every 5 seconds, and if no communication occurs within this interval, a handshake error is triggered.
We recently reviewed the charger, and both connectors are currently in use and charging without any issues.
Please let us know if you have any further questions or concerns. If not, we will proceed with closing this ticket.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey

Thanks for your support and patience, according to our records your issue/query has been resolved for case # 0425695, the case is now closed.
Problem Description
: Terminal-Card Connection Issues
Resolution
: Query addressed in the trailing email. EcoG faces disconnection due to which the handshake is not being done, there is no issue in the charger related to Terminal card connection.
If you need any further assistance, please do reach back out to us by submitting a new request at
